title: My Slain Dragon Bride
altTitles: The Dragon Bride That Was Slain by Me
description: A man who once killed a powerful dragon finds himself entangled with the dragon's bride and the consequences of his past actions. As hidden truths surrounding the dragon, its bride, and their world begin to surface, he is forced to confront the choices that led to the dragon's death while navigating a dangerous relationship filled with mystery, fantasy, and unexpected revelations.
author: Kang Tae-hoon
